# A half-migrated vault

Both forms on one line, and both forms in one file — the shape a vault takes
while a user is moving between tools.

- [ ] one of each 📅 2026-08-01 [priority:: high]
- [ ] the other order [due:: 2026-08-01] 🔁 every week
- [ ] emoji then description 📅 2026-08-01 then some words
- [ ] description between fields [due:: 2026-08-01] the plumber [priority:: low]
- [X] uppercase marker with fields 📅 2026-07-30 [priority:: medium]
- [ ] fields in prose, not a task line, live below

Ordinary prose carrying a due-looking field [due:: 2026-08-01] is still
recognized by the parser — the line-task restriction belongs to the consumer.

Shipped it ✅ 2026-07-27 in a sentence, likewise.
